label: Join / Union Sources
description: Combine sources with Join or Union logic.

fields.help: Union appends rows from both files into one combined output. No matching key is needed.

english.default: {{#if (eq (upper (trim param.join_type)) "UNION")}}{{phrase "analyst_logic.union_sources.default" left_source=(quote (orEmpty (orEmpty param.left_source param.union_left_source) "")) right_source=(quote (orEmpty (orEmpty param.right_source param.union_right_source) "")) output_source=(quote (orEmpty (orEmpty param.output_source step.source) ""))}}{{else if (gt (count (joinKeyPairs param)) 1)}}{{phrase "analyst_logic.join.multi" left_column=(tableColumn param.left_source param.left_alias param.left_field) right_column=(tableColumn param.right_source param.right_alias param.right_field) additional_keys=(joinKeyList param style="additional")}}{{else}}{{phrase "analyst_logic.join.default" left_column=(tableColumn param.left_source param.left_alias param.left_field) right_column=(tableColumn param.right_source param.right_alias param.right_field)}}{{/if}}

autoNotes.default: {{#if (eq (upper (trim param.join_type)) "UNION")}}{{phrase "notes.union" left_source=(orEmpty (orEmpty param.left_source param.union_left_source) (placeholder "file_1" "[file 1]")) right_source=(orEmpty (orEmpty param.right_source param.union_right_source) (placeholder "file_2" "[file 2]")) output_source=(orEmpty param.output_source (placeholder "combined_file" "[combined file]"))}}{{else}}{{phrase (concat "notes.join." (orEmpty param.join_type "DEFAULT")) left_alias=(orEmpty (orEmpty param.left_alias param.left_source) (placeholder "file_1" "[file 1]")) right_alias=(orEmpty (orEmpty param.right_alias param.right_source) (placeholder "file_2" "[file 2]")) keys=(joinKeyList param style="notes")}}{{/if}}

variants.excel: =VSTACK({{excelTable (alias (orEmpty param.left_source param.union_left_source) (orEmpty param.left_alias param.union_left_alias))}}, {{excelTable (alias (orEmpty param.right_source param.union_right_source) (orEmpty param.right_alias param.union_right_alias))}})
variants.python: df = pd.concat([{{pySource (alias (orEmpty param.left_source param.union_left_source) (orEmpty param.left_alias param.union_left_alias))}}, {{pySource (alias (orEmpty param.right_source param.union_right_source) (orEmpty param.right_alias param.union_right_alias))}}], ignore_index=True)

fileUtility.when: INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN, RIGHT JOIN, FULL OUTER JOIN, UNION; not inside an IF branch

outcomes.atlas: {{#if (eq (upper (trim param.join_type)) "UNION")}}Records from {{quote (orEmpty (orEmpty param.left_source param.union_left_source) "")}} and {{quote (orEmpty (orEmpty param.right_source param.union_right_source) "")}} are combined into {{quote (orEmpty (orEmpty param.output_source step.source) "")}}.{{else}}Records are matched where {{#each (joinKeyPairs param blank=true) separator=" and "}}{{tableColumn @root.param.left_source @root.param.left_alias this.left_field}} equals {{tableColumn @root.param.right_source @root.param.right_alias this.right_field}}{{/each}}; joined values display on the {{record}}.{{/if}}
outcomes.source: {{#if (eq (upper (trim param.join_type)) "UNION")}}The combined record count reconciles to the records in {{quote (orEmpty (orEmpty param.left_source param.union_left_source) "")}} and {{quote (orEmpty (orEmpty param.right_source param.union_right_source) "")}}.{{else}}Source values for {{#each (joinKeyPairs param blank=true) separator=", "}}{{tableColumn @root.param.left_source @root.param.left_alias this.left_field}} and {{tableColumn @root.param.right_source @root.param.right_alias this.right_field}}{{/each}} agree for each joined record.{{/if}}
